f0bbac64-efe5-4403-9fcf-5454db36467a.title: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai no Doutei Henkyou Ryoushu Kishi
f0bbac64-efe5-4403-9fcf-5454db36467a.altTitle: Virgin Frontier Lord Knight In The Chastity-Switched World
f0bbac64-efe5-4403-9fcf-5454db36467a.description:
Reborn from modern Japan into a medieval fantasy world where gender roles are flipped, Faust is an anomaly—a rare male knight! Raised as a frontier lord, his old-world values clash hilariously with his new life. The queen's attire leaves little to the imagination, and the busty duke's "friendly" advances verge on harassment! Despite getting flustered in court, Faust is a dazzling hero on the battlefield whose prowess can turn the tide of any battle. When Faust is tasked with advising Princess Valiele on her first mission, what was meant to be a simple skirmish against bandits quickly spirals into an unimaginable trial.
___
**Character Designer:** [Melonnyinyi](https://mangadex.org/author/e26bb514-85e4-4383-bc9e-9178797466f2)

chapters.title: Even Though You're Just a Virgin!

49c09cc3-6e2d-458f-9a54-7fa5ecae1f6f.title: The Reborn Young Lord Is an Assassin
49c09cc3-6e2d-458f-9a54-7fa5ecae1f6f.altTitle: The Regressed Youngest Son of the Duke Is an Assassin
49c09cc3-6e2d-458f-9a54-7fa5ecae1f6f.description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

---
Cyan Vert, the best assassin of the continent, meets a pitiful death after having been betrayed by his own brother, whom he had trusted all his life.

"If I were given another chance at life, I would live it differently. I would only trust myself, and achieve all the things I want on my own without serving anyone else but myself."

That is how he was given a second chance at life. Cyan Vert, a shadow who lived for others, is no more. He will now pave a path on his own, for only him!

8280b28c-aeff-4f89-ac99-a4c783e14782.title: Tensei Shite High Elf ni Narimashitaga, Slow Life wa 120-nen de Akimashita - Highelf with a Long Life
8280b28c-aeff-4f89-ac99-a4c783e14782.altTitle: I was Reborn and Became a High Elf, but I Got Tired of My Slow Life after 120 Years
8280b28c-aeff-4f89-ac99-a4c783e14782.description:
Life in the Great Pulha Woodlands is the very definition of stillness and tranquility—and Aesir's had enough of it! That's right. Aesir isn't quite like the other high elves of the forest. For starters, he remembers living a past life as a human in another world... meaning he's got a taste for meat, adventure, and plenty of other decidedly un-elven things! He's also bored out of his skull after 120 years of the peace and quiet of their serene sylvan lifestyle. So with nothing more than his trusty bow, a bundle of life-giving fruit, and his close bond with the spirits of nature, Aesir leaves the monotony of the forest behind to seek a new life, one that's more his pace.
___
* [Official English Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/enough-with-this-slow-life-i-was-reincarnated-as-a-high-elf-and-now-i-m-bored)

df162de1-bdcd-424c-a93e-50f692ca07f9.title: Rinkoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou
df162de1-bdcd-424c-a93e-50f692ca07f9.altTitle: My Wife from the Neighboring Country Is So Cute, I Don't Know What to Do!
df162de1-bdcd-424c-a93e-50f692ca07f9.description: Saryu, known as the Winter Bear of Tidros for his formidable presence that scatters enemies, suddenly finds himself in an engagement with Lady Shitoen, a noblewoman from a neighboring kingdom whose previous engagement was called off! Starting with a forehead kiss, he's nervous around a woman he's not used to. Her smile makes his heart race, and a glimpse of her chest leaves him flustered. As improper fantasies run wild in his mind, Saryu's rationality is on the verge of collapse!?

f99fcba8-6ae7-418f-9e1e-cdc1e045f2c1.title: Neko no Te: Cat Maids
f99fcba8-6ae7-418f-9e1e-cdc1e045f2c1.description:
The "Cat's Paw" system is an ancient custom shared between the Kingdom of Cats and the human village of Floraville. Under this custom, a cat from the kingdom lives among the humans to lend a helping hand, symbolizing the enduring friendship between humans and cats.

Nowadays, a "Cat's Paw" is dispatched to the village only once every few years. The latest is Crochet, a black cat who loves nothing more than a good nap. And so, Crochet's new life is about to begin...!

(Source: PIE International, translated)

52e665bf-3ccc-4c9f-9f6a-d475c4cfbfd2.title: My Happy Home
52e665bf-3ccc-4c9f-9f6a-d475c4cfbfd2.description:
This manhwa contains animal death(sheep). Viewer discretion is advised. 

**“Even if you’re here, nobody will welcome you!”**

5 years ago I left my home for the city. 
Mihail, who wandered around without no one to rely on, fails to settle down and eventually returns to his hometown. Which is a remote mountain valley rural village where even carts do not take you all the way. As soon as he arrived, he went back to the cabin of his one and only childhood friend, the shepherd, Caleb. He greeted him warmly, but all he got back were words demanding he leave immediately. Mihail tries to change Caleb's mind so that he can get along well in his hometown. Although, things don't go as easily as expected..

bea3a963-9adb-4dbd-b0bc-1a4fba7f23e6.title: "Osananajimi ga Hoshii" to Tsubuyaitara Yoku Issho ni Asobu Onna Tomodachi no Yousu ga Hen ni Natta ndaga
bea3a963-9adb-4dbd-b0bc-1a4fba7f23e6.altTitle: When I Murmured, "I Want a Childhood Friend," the Behavior of My Female Friend I Often Hang Out with Changed.
bea3a963-9adb-4dbd-b0bc-1a4fba7f23e6.description: "I want a cute girl as a childhood friend..." ― It was a casual remark made by Akito while having lunch with his usual friend group of four. However, he didn't know that the person sitting right in front of him, Natsumi, was actually his childhood friend who had moved away when they were small! Since then, Natsumi has been trying to express her feelings to Akito, but because they had always been friends, it hasn't been easy for her to convey them...

e1b8201e-8442-4e6b-81cb-f5105ba214a2.title: Ijimete Kureru Kimi ga Suki
e1b8201e-8442-4e6b-81cb-f5105ba214a2.altTitle: I Like You Because You Bully Me
e1b8201e-8442-4e6b-81cb-f5105ba214a2.description:
Yuzuru Tachibana, a high school girl with family problems, was frustrated by her unsuccessful days.

One day, she overheard her classmate, Kae Shijima, talking about her father buying her an expensive coat, and Yuzuru made her her target for bullying.

For a while, Yuzuru enjoyed the bullying, but when her friends warned her that she'd be expelled if they found out, she lost interest and stopped.

However—even though she was no longer directing the bullying, Kae suddenly wet herself during class…

e421aa24-46c5-472d-b587-b8e42fb3803a.description:
"In these ruins, only machines, Variants and Dolls remain, masterless. Weapons born without enemies wander within the womb, fighting among themselves."

A nameless mecha-girl, born in the colossal megastructure of "Hod," ventures into the endless abyss in search of the body of Nehma — her master.

d803df2d-9706-41ed-8b45-cc6fe3b10185.title: Almark
d803df2d-9706-41ed-8b45-cc6fe3b10185.description:
Born the son of a mercenary in the war-torn north, Almark sets out on a long journey to the Nork Academy of Magic in the south to fulfill a promise he made to his father to become a sorcerer. After a long journey, his life at the academy was completely different from the world he was in. Almark is always confused by the gap. However, while making mistakes, with the help of his colleagues and teachers, he gradually shows a glimpse of his talent. With the pride of being the son of a mercenary, Almark takes the first step toward becoming a sorcerer.
___
**Character Designer:** [Demizu Posuka](https://mangadex.org/author/2ebfaeb3-3b72-4aa5-8c00-64b804b3a905)
